html:
You might be getting confused thinking about which phone can suit you best for daily use and still fit your 50,000 taka budget? Because spending that much money means expecting a smart phone under 50K taka to perform near-flagship, offer high-quality cameras, and have long-lasting battery life. This late 2026 comes with some of the best smartphones under 50K, in this upper-mid-range price segment. But your search can still feel tough, as there are many smartphone brands pushing the same specs.

This comprehensive blog will help you discover and compare the top 5 phones under 50000 taka currently available in Bangladesh and bring you clarity to your decision-making process by the end of this guide.

As you see, we have compared key specifications, features, performance, and value to help you because there is always clear uncertainty about which brand offers better value specifically for your needs. Now here are our under 50000 BDT mobile phone contenders in detail:

Infinix Note 60 PRO | Lightning Touch Response for Serious Gamers

Do you play fast games every day on your mobile phone? Then the Infinix Note 60 Pro is the best gaming phone under 50000 for you. Its Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chip and 8GB LPDDR5 RAM keep heavy games smooth. Besides, there is UFS 2.2 storage for loading big game files quickly. Extended RAM can add up to 8GB more for background apps on this Infinix smartphone.

A 144Hz AMOLED screen reacts fast, and instant touch sampling can reach up to 2800Hz on every tap. Sounds promising, right? In this way, your thumbs will feel each move without delay. Its 6500 mAh battery ensures your high chances to last through long sessions, and the 90 W charger also cuts downtime. Dual JBL speakers give clear sound for every footstep. These strengths place the Infinix Note 60 PRO among the best phones under 50000 taka for players.

Key Features of Infinix Note 60 Pro

  • Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chip
  • 8GB LPDDR5 RAM and 256GB storage
  • 6.78-inch 144Hz AMOLED display
  • 6500 mAh battery with 90 W charging
  • Dual JBL speakers

Samsung Galaxy A27 5G | Six Years of Updates, Zero Upgrade Stress

While the Infinix wins on speed, the Samsung Galaxy A27 5G wins on long-term support. Samsung promises up to six OS upgrades and six years of security updates as well. That promise clearly makes the Galaxy A27 5G the best official phone under 50000 in Bangladesh for people who plan to keep their phones for years. Security updates stay valid until 31st July, 2032. Your phone stays safe for years if you choose this Samsung phone within this budget.

So, if you want the best 5G phone under 50000 BDT with room to grow, this model offers Sub-6 5G, which includes both low-band and mid-band spectrums, and a 6.7-inch 120 Hz Super AMOLED screen. A microSD slot accepts cards up to 2TB, so storage never runs short. Samsung Knox Vault also protects your private data. The 5000mAh battery is also ready to handle a full day of use.

Key Features of Samsung Galaxy A27

  • Up to six Android upgrades
  • Six years of security updates
  • 6.7-inch 120Hz Super AMOLED screen
  • Sub-6 5G support
  • microSD slot up to 2TB

HONOR X9d: A Giant 8300mAh Battery That Outlasts Your Day

Long support means little when your phone dies by evening, and the HONOR X9d fixes that. Its 8300 mAh silicon-carbon battery is the best battery for a smartphone under 50000 for heavy users. A 66W charger refills it fast, and reverse charging will let this Honor phone power your other gadgets. The 12GB RAM also keeps your apps fast.

IP69K, IP68, and IP66 ratings protect it from dust and water. HONOR tests show it survives drops up to 2.5m. That rugged build earns the HONOR X9d a spot among the top 5 best smartphones under 50000 taka. The 6.79-inch 1.5K AMOLED screen reaches 6000 nits at peak, so you can read it in a strong sun.

Key Features of HONOR X9d

  • 8300 mAh silicon-carbon battery
  • 66W fast charging
  • IP69K, IP68, and IP66 protection
  • 12GB RAM and 256GB storage
  • 6.79-inch 1.5K AMOLED display

Realme 15 5G: Sharp 50MP Sony Shots, Day or Night

This Realme phone is going to shift our focus to photos. Its 50MP Sony IMX882 main camera uses OIS, so night shots and videos stay steady. This makes the realme 15 5G the best camera phone under 50000 for daily photos. The f/1.8 aperture also pulls in more light. The 8MP ultra-wide lens fits more people in group shots.

A 50MP front camera records 4K selfie video, and front EIS steadies your hands. Shoppers who search for the top 5 mobile phones under 50000 taka should shortlist it for this reason. Its 7000mAh battery handles a full day of shooting, and the 80W charger tops it up fast.

Key Features of Realme 15 5G

  • 50MP Sony IMX882 main camera with OIS
  • 50MP front camera
  • 12GB RAM with up to 14GB dynamic RAM
  • 6.77-inch 144Hz AMOLED screen
  • 7000mAh battery with 80W charging

TECNO CAMON Air: Ultra-Slim Body with a Glowing Mini-LED Back

Big batteries add bulk, so the TECNO CAMON Air goes slim instead. It measures just 6.4mm and weighs about 167g. For style fans, this Tecno phone is the best phone under 50k in BD. The IP68 and IP69 ratings still protect it from dust and water. The 6000mAh battery and 60W charging keep it useful all day.

Due to having a 6.78-inch with 144 Hz panel, we are reviewing the Tecno Camon Air as the best AMOLED display smartphone under 50000 that prioritizes a large screen with a higher refresh rate. A programmable Mini-LED matrix on the back adds a unique look. Dolby Atmos stereo speakers add rich sound. The 32MP front camera also takes sharp selfies. However, the Tecno phone runs on 4G LTE, so skip it if you need 5G.

Key Features of Tecno CAMON Air

  • 6.4mm slim body at about 167 g
  • 6.78-inch 144Hz AMOLED display
  • 8GB RAM and 256GB storage
  • 6000mAh battery with 60W charging
  • IP68 and IP69 protection

The Realme 15 5G is the best camera phone. Its OIS main camera keeps shots steady, with its 50MP Sony IMX882 main camera and 50MP front camera with 4K video recording capability.

Question-3:

The Infinix Note 60 Pro is the best gaming phone. Its fast chip suits heavy games, powered by the Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 chip, and a 144 Hz display with 2800 Hz touch sampling.

Question-4:

The HONOR X9d has the best battery. Its 8300 mAh cell is the largest here, with its silicon-carbon battery and 66 W fast charging speed.

Question-5:

The Samsung Galaxy A27 5G is best for long-term use. It has the longest update promise with up to six OS upgrades and six years of long-term security updates.
